newsitem.title: USA: Axis, ParentNet offer Internet day care monitoring.
newsitem.headline: Axis, ParentNet offer Internet day care monitoring.

text.p: Axis Communications Inc and ParentNet Inc said Thursday they have introduced the KinderCam System, a camera monitor for daycare centers that is linked to the Internet.
The technology allows parents to have a live view of their children's daycare rooms at anytime, from anywhere via their personal computers, the companies said.
The system uses Axis Communication's NetEye 200 Internet camera which is both a video monitor and an Internet server.
